ch7-fee-setup-page.en: Let's update the fees for a class.
Open Finance, then Fee Setup. The Monthly Structure tab shows the monthly fee of each class.
Choose By Class, then press Edit on the class you want to change.
Change the amount for the fee category. You can add or remove charges here too.
Press Review and Save to check the new total before it's saved.
Press Confirm and Save. Fee records you generate later will use this amount.
ch7-interaccount-transfers.en: Let's move money between two accounts.
Open Finance, then Accounts, and go to the Transfers tab.
Choose the account the money leaves, and the account that receives it.
Enter the amount and a short description.
Press Review Transfer to check the details before anything is saved.
Press Confirm Transfer. Both account balances update, and the transfer appears in the list.
ch7-managing-discounts-scholarships.en: Let's set up discounts and scholarships.
Open Finance, then Discounts. It has three tabs: Discounts, Scholarships and Student Assignments.
On the Discounts tab, press Add Discount.
Enter the discount name. Choose the type, Percentage or Fixed Amount, and enter the value.
In Applies To, choose all students, a grade level, a class, or siblings. You can also set dates, and make the discount stackable.
Press Create Discount, and the new discount appears in the list.
Scholarships work the same way, with Merit, Need, Sports or Staff Child types. Assign them to students from Fee Setup.
ch7-month-closing.en: Let's close the books for a month.
Open Finance, then Accounts. Close Month is at the top of the page.
At the month's end, press Close Month and pick the month and year.
Closing locks the period: no transactions can be added or edited in that month afterwards. Tick the box to confirm.
Press Close Month again, and the page now shows the last closed month.
ch7-other-income.en: Let's record income that isn't fees.
Open Finance, then Other Income. Use it for income that is not fees, such as sales and donations.
Enter the amount, then choose the category and the account that receives the money.
Add a short description. The date is today by default.
Press Add Income. The entry appears in the list, and the total is shown at the top.
ch7-recording-expenses.en: Enter the amount, the category, the account that pays, and a description. The date is today by default.
Save, and the expense is recorded while the account balance updates.
Filter by category to review expenses by type.
ch7-recording-payments.en: Tick the student's row in the fee table.
In the bar that appears, enter the amount, the account and the payment method.
Press Update, then confirm with Yes. Or use Pay Full to take the whole balance. The status updates by itself.
ch7-setting-up-finance-accounts.en: Let's set up your finance accounts.
Open Finance, then Accounts, and go to Manage Accounts.
Enter the account name and choose its type: Cash, Bank or Person. Then enter the opening balance.
Keep Visible to Staff ticked if staff members should see this account.
Press Save, and the new account appears in the list. Create at least one Cash and one Bank account before collecting fees.
ch8-adding-staff-members.en: Let's add a new staff member.
Open HR and Staff, then Staff Directory. It lists everyone who works at the school.
Press Full Form to open the complete staff form.
Enter the first and last name, then the email and phone number.
Choose the department and the designation. Both are optional, but they make reports and payroll easier.
Press Add Staff Member. A login account is optional and can be added later. The new staff member appears in the directory.
ch8-leave-management.en: Open HR and Staff, then Leave.
Find the pending request. It shows the leave type, the dates and the reason.
Approve or reject it, and add remarks if you like.
When a request is approved, the leave balance updates automatically.
ch8-letter-composer.en: Open HR and Staff, then Letter Composer.
Under To, press Employee and pick the staff member. Their name and ID fill in automatically.
Choose a Quick Draft Template, such as Warning Letter. The subject and body are written for you, with the employee details filled in.
Read the preview and edit the text. Replace the REASON placeholder with the real reason before you generate the PDF.
Press Generate PDF. The letter downloads on your school letterhead, and is saved in the history below.
ch8-linking-unlinking-user-accounts.en: Let's link a staff member to a user account.
Open HR and Staff, then the Staff Directory. Search for Hina, who has no login yet.
Press Link Account to connect her to an existing user.
Search for the user by name or username.
Click the right user. The account is linked, and the username shows on her row.
To remove the link, press Unlink.
Confirm. The user account is not deleted, only the link is removed.
ch8-payroll-processing.en: Let's run payroll for the month.
Open HR and Staff, then Payroll. It shows one month at a time.
Press Generate Payslips, then confirm. A payslip is made for every staff member with a salary structure.
Each payslip starts as a draft. Press Approve on one to check and confirm it.
After you pay the salary, press Mark Paid.
Press View to see the full breakdown of the payslip.
Press Download PDF. The file is saved to your Downloads folder, named with the staff name, month and year. The PDF button on each row does the same.
ch8-performance-appraisals.en: Open HR and Staff, then Performance. This page keeps every staff review.
Set the start and end dates of the review period.
Click the stars to give a rating. Four stars means Good.
Write the strengths, and the goals for the next period.
Press Create, and the review now shows in the list with its rating.
